notes.title: New Mode! New Bats!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29077992/b4a3c7eb960e9faea3873e39436977c201a40227.png[/img]
Hi sluggers! 
We just update VR Slugger today.

Change Log:
[*]Legend Mode - Facing legend pitchers, beat them all.
[*]Pratice Mode - Now you can do some swing pratice here without time limit.
[*]Add several funny bats. Clear game mode to unlock.
[*]Add several exciting breaking balls including super slow ball.
[*]Add batter rating system. The goal is S+ class.
[*]New designed LED screen.
[*]Improved UI and effects.
[*]Add a new laguage: Korean.
[*]Fixed minor issues.

Hope you guys will like this update.
Pick your bat! Swing big! Knock it out of the park!
